title: The merge tool refuses a review record whose rounds name a head other than --head
why: Coordinator 13:12 CST Nov 8, from lane agent-report-shas-resolve (session_013NEJL1333yS5ziKFeWsjHC), 13:11 CST: the merge tool accepted a record on #2235 at 660db61b0 whose rounds 1-3 read #1864's heads. The tool must refuse a record whose rounds name a head other than --head, unless it is a tool-checked fix-check chain. Triage checked overlap: review-record-past-head (#2200) covers recording a past round for a head no longer live, and replacement-pr-carries-review (#2207) allows a replacement PR with an identical tree to name the replaced PR's record; neither refuses a mismatched head. This step keeps #2207's identical-tree case as a tool-checked exception.
